design.recognition: The depth-1 scan recognises features before root type even after name, crs or other metadata.
design.marker: rootTypePending is internal; its warning uses the existing card limits array.
design.ordering: SourceFeature.collectionTypeBeforeFeatures is recomputed from byte zero on every read.
design.publication: Type-first collections publish each accepted slot while reading, with the original pre-seal watermark check.
design.seal: Only late-type collections hold slots until root closure, original integrity and CRS validation pass.
design.refusal: Held collections publish no parts or terminal marker; GEOJSON_COLLECTION_TYPE words stay unchanged.
design.exhaustion: Without another read, a published prefix permits its usual failure marker; no prefix fails closed.
